questions.question: Which Greek philosopher is most closely associated with the dialectical method involving questioning to uncover truths?

What activity of a philosopher involves setting standards for evaluating conduct or art?

options.B: Recognizing one's own biases and predispositions

questions.question: Which activity involves gathering information to form a unified whole?

questions.question: Why is deductive reasoning strongly associated with speculative activity in philosophy?

options.A: It relies on empirical data collection.
options.B: It starts with general premises and aligns with imaginative theorizing.

questions.question: How is inductive reasoning linked to analytical activity in philosophy?

options.A: It prioritizes abstract theories over evidence.
options.B: It involves collecting specific cases to form generalizations, requiring critical examination.
options.D: It relies on defending unverified assumptions.
